name: fast_tool_manager
description:
A single-step manager for calendar, reminder, and todo tasks. Use this when the user request is simple and can be handled with one tool call.
Fast, single-tool manager for routine tasks (calendar, reminders, todo).
Use when the request is a straightforward one-step action or lookup.
arguments_prompt:

Provide the task and any additional information needed for the fast_tool_manager.
